propositions: Import-time breakage in rebar subpackages (e.g. git adapter in helpers, fastapi-dependent modules) and scripts/ modules (bare imports without sys.path setup) currently escape the wheel-probe CI step because it only runs `import rebar` and entry-point `--help` calls, missing subpackage and scripts/ import failures

A deterministic import walk must cover every module under the installed rebar package tree and every top-level scripts/*.py file in isolated child processes (to prevent one script's sys.path.insert from masking a sibling's missing setup), collecting and reporting all failures non-fatally

Expected-optional modules (rebar._mcp_auth, rebar.opcert_service.app, rebar.review_bot.app for uninstalled extras [mcp], [reviewbot], [ui]) must be attempted but recorded as skips only when their declared missing dependency is absent; any other failure or failure with the dependency present is a real failure

The walk must be locally runnable without CI infrastructure (`python scripts/check_import_walk.py` in a checkout with rebar installed) and testable via RED-first regression tests that recreate pre-fix import failures (bare sibling imports, multiple broken modules).
